## R Markdown

```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb.db")
listings = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings")

```

```{r}
nrow(listings)                                    # A1
sum(listings$city == "Columbus")                  # A2
length(unique(listings$neighbourhood[listings$city == "Chicago"]))  # A4
sum(listings$host_is_superhost == "t", na.rm = TRUE)   #A5
sum(listings$price > 1000)        #A6
```

```{r}
chicago = listings[listings$city == "Chicago", ]
chicago[which.max(chicago$price), "name"]
```
